payload.entry: CoordinatedRead in retry.rs is the single injectable pace+retry+latch layer for every Gmail read (search, labels, metadata, hydration, policy, attachments). Sticky latches fire from raw inner errors before save/policy re-label: invalid_grant aborts the whole run with a body-free runtime failure and no vault write or journal; wait-budget / retry give-up defers the current candidate and every remaining unprepared key. SharedBudget is wait-only (guard contention, retry backoff, vault-lock waits); ordinary 200ms pacing always applies including at -r 0 and never consumes the budget. Non-auth search failures keep discovered ids, still run adoption/recovery, and report ok=false. Busy vault skip stays quiet exit-0 when prep recorded no failure, and keeps ok=false plus warnings when it did. Report membership uses the apply snapshot when apply ran, else the run's own scan. Fast-forwarded onto origin/master f9601b70 (capture later-start) before close; gmail/sync/guard.rs auto-merged. Verified: cargo test -p bob-obsidian --lib gmail:: (380 passed); cargo test -p bob-obsidian --test gmail_sync --test gmail_shell --test gmail_pull_attach (8+59+2 passed); cargo fmt --all -- --check; just lint. sase bead epic-symbols bob-cli-in.1 reported none.
